title: Weight ladder, no new color
description: All three states keep the same amber (--color-accent-text), but differentiate through weight, letter-spacing, and size instead: SALIENDO is heaviest (800/16px/0.12em), ABORDANDO medium (700/10px/0.1em), PRÓXIMO lightest (500/9px/0.06em). Establishes hierarchy purely via typography, staying strictly palette-legal.

changes.intent: SALIENDO gets the heaviest treatment in the ladder — most urgent state.
ABORDANDO gets a medium weight/size, between SALIENDO and PRÓXIMO.
PRÓXIMO gets the lightest treatment — least urgent of the three attention states.
